why: A written answer opens with 'The following question stood in the name of  **Mr Gan Thiam Poh** –', two spaces before the bold name. The lead-in keeps a PROCEDURAL row as printed, and the label is the name.
title: Ridership on Downtown Line
html:
The following question stood in the name of  Mr Gan Thiam Poh –

1 To ask the Minister for Transport (a) what is the average ridership on the Downtown Line during the morning and evening peak and non-peak hours since it started operations in December 2013; (b) how much has the Downtown Line helped alleviate the load on the North East Line during the morning and evening peak hours; and (c) whether the Downtown Line has also eased the load on the Circle Line during peak hours.

Mr Ong Teng Koon (Sembawang): Question No 1.
